info.name: Baserow API spec Admin Audit log API

params.name: action_type
params.description: Filter the audit log entries by action type.

params.name: from_timestamp
params.description: The ISO timestamp to filter the audit log entries from.

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of audit log entries IDs to filter by. When provided, only audit log entries with those IDs are returned.

params.name: page
params.description: Defines which page should be returned.

params.name: size
params.description: Defines how many audit log entries should be returned per page.

params.name: sorts
params.description: A comma separated string of attributes to sort by, each attribute must be prefixed with `+` for a descending sort or a `-` for an ascending sort. The accepted attribute names are: `user, workspace, type, timestamp, ip_address`. For example `sorts=-user,-workspace` will sort the audit log entries first by descending user and then ascending workspace. A sortparameter with multiple instances of the same sort attribute will respond with the ERROR_INVALID_SORT_ATTRIBUTE error.

params.name: to_timestamp
params.description: The ISO timestamp to filter the audit log entries to.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Filter the audit log entries by user id.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Filter the audit log entries by workspace id. This filter works only for the admin audit log.

items.docs:
Lists all audit log entries for the given workspace id.

This is a **enterprise** feature.

params.name: search
params.description: If provided only action_types with name that match the query will be returned.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Return action types related to the workspace.

items.docs:
List all distinct action types related to an audit log entry.

This is a **enterprise** feature.

Creates a job to export the filtered audit log to a CSV file.

This is a **enterprise** feature.

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of users IDs to filter by. When provided, only users with those IDs are returned.

params.name: page
params.description: Defines which page should be returned.

params.name: search
params.description: If provided only users with email that match the query will be returned.

params.name: size
params.description: Defines how many users should be returned per page.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Return users belonging to the given workspace_id.

items.docs:
List all users that have performed an action in the audit log.

This is a **enterprise** feature.
